title: Nature study camp, day 1
storyboard: Film: kids arriving at camp gate, guide's briefing circle, torch-lit night walk (3 vertical shots)
caption:
Day 1 of nature study camp, in 15 seconds.

The kingfisher on our dawn walk has a big appetite: common kingfishers eat around 60% of their body weight every day.
